```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Set Environment and load packages
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

rm(list=ls())
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

if("pacman" %in% installed.packages() == FALSE) {install.packages("pacman")}
pacman::p_load(psych,
               ggplot2,
               tidyverse,
               magrittr,
               gmodels,
               foreign,
               ggcorrplot,
               Hmisc,
               DT,
               afex,
               lsmeans,
               rstatix,
               effectsize,
               cocor,
               sjPlot,
               sjmisc,
               reghelper,
               jtools,
               lavaan,
               plyr,
               ggdark,
               overlapping,
               corrr,
               pwr,
               ggpubr)

# Set your own wd here
setwd("")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in data and set up merged df
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

# Load in data from study 4
load("./Study 4 cleaned and recoded (dis con).rda")

study4_df <- merged_df

# Just to keep things cleaned up
rm(merged_df)

# add study identifier
study4_df %<>% mutate(study = "study4")

# Load in data from pilot to study 4
load("./Pilot to Study 4 cleaned and recoded (dis con).rda")

pilotstudy4_df <- merged_df

# Again, for cleanliness
rm(merged_df)

# add study identifier
pilotstudy4_df %<>% mutate(study = "pilot")

# Create illness harm composite for pilot data
pilotstudy4_df %<>% rowwise() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(harm_final = mean(c(trans_risk, severity_final), na.rm = TRUE))

# combine data frames
combined_df <- rbind.fill(study4_df, pilotstudy4_df)

# Center harm and stigma
combined_df %<>% mutate(harm_final_c = scale(harm_final, center = TRUE),
                        cur_stigma_c = scale(cur_stigma, center = TRUE),
                        salience_c = scale(salience, center = TRUE),
                        centrality_c = scale(centrality, center = TRUE))

# Filter out problems. Note that we want to only filter out problem = 1 because problem = N/A for condition "not sick"
combined_df %<>% filter(problem == 0 | is.na(problem))
```

```{r severity distribution plots}
# Study 4 symptom severity distribution
study4_distribution <- study4_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = severity_final, group = condition, fill = condition, color = condition)) +
  geom_density(adjust = 2, alpha = .4) +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("Healthy", "Sick"), values = c("#88CCEE", "#332288")) +
  scale_color_manual(labels = c("Healthy", "Sick"), values = c("#88CCEE", "#332288")) +
  labs(title = "B. Study 4",
       y = "Density",
       x = "Symptom Severity",
       fill = "Participant Illness Status",
       color = "Participant Illness Status") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title.x = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black" , size = 12, hjust = .5))

# Pilot distribution of illness harm
pilotstudy4_distribution <- pilotstudy4_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = severity_final, group = condition, fill = condition, color = condition)) +
  geom_density(adjust = 2, alpha = .4) +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("Healthy", "Sick"), values = c("#88CCEE", "#332288")) +
  scale_color_manual(labels = c("Healthy", "Sick"), values = c("#88CCEE", "#332288")) +
  labs(title = "A. Study 4 Pilot",
       y = "Density",
       x = "Symptom Severity",
       fill = "Participant Illness Status",
       color = "Participant Illness Status") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title.x = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black" , size = 12, hjust = .5))

pilotstudy4_distribution

ggarrange(pilotstudy4_distribution, study4_distribution, ncol = 2, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "bottom")
```

```{r multiple regression analyses}
# Descriptives
describeBy(select(combined_df, conceal_co), group = combined_df$condition)

# Main effects of harm, condition, and interaction with study as a covariate
conceal_lm <- lm(conceal_co ~ harm_final_c * condition + study, data = filter(combined_df))
summary(conceal_lm)

simple_slopes(conceal_lm)

# Plot for manuscript
combined_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = harm_final, y = conceal_co, fill = condition)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = condition), alpha = .25) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("Healthy", "Sick"), values = c("#88CCEE", "#332288")) +
  scale_color_manual(labels = c("Healthy", "Sick"), values = c("#88CCEE", "#332288")) +
  labs(title = "Concealment likelihood by illness harm  and illness status (Pilot and Study 4 combined)",
       y = "Concealment Likelihood",
       x = "Illness Harm",
       fill = "Participant Illness Status",
       color = "Participant Illness Status") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title.x = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black" , size = 12, hjust = .5))

# Add CSI
conceal_csilm <- lm(conceal_co ~ harm_final_c * condition + study + cur_stigma_c + salience_c + centrality_c,
                    data = combined_df)

summary(conceal_csilm)
```
